topic: Why smart teams agree their way into bad decisions: groupthink, how it starts in ordinary meetings, and simple habits that break it

request.audience: employees and team leads in corporate teams who run or sit in decision meetings
request.notes: TED-Ed style: a small illustrated story world, one running example team, hand-made feel, warm but adult, never teacherly. Use the story-cartoon look with stepped time, morphs and a page or torn-paper join material. No invented statistics.
